title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
text: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
text: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.

title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
text: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
text: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
text: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
text: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
text: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
text: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
text: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.

title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
text: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
text: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

title: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion
text: Widespread AI adoption is propelling Southeast Asia's digital economy to a projected $368 billion in 2026 and $1 trillion by 2035.

title: Democratic governance of frontier AI, part II: Empowering cyber defenders
text: OpenAI outlines a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders with frontier AI, stronger safeguards, modernized cybersecurity, and more resilient public institutions.

title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
text: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
text: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
text: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
text: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
text: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
